heroEyebrow: A test that became a testimony
heroHeadline: Finding light in the storm, one healed day at a time
heroSubtext: This is my journal of sickness, surrender, and the perfect timings of Christ — written to encourage anyone still waiting on their own miracle.
heroVerseText: "For I know the plans I have for you, plans to prosper you and not to harm you, plans to give you hope and a future."
aboutBio: I am Blessy Mary. I earned a degree in Electronics Engineering and planned to work as an engineer, but God had a different plan. Diagnosed with a recurring and inoperable brain tumor during college, I went through a test that became my testimony. This journey made me passionate about understanding His Word, His Will, and His perfect timings. Today, holding an MSc in Counselling Psychology, I share my experiences here to encourage others and glorify God.
